name: rpchat
description: 로컬 LLM 기반 개인용 RP 캐릭터 채팅 PWA (Tailscale 사설망 전용)

scripts.test:chat-events: TSX_TSCONFIG_PATH=apps/web/tsconfig.json RPCHAT_PROMPT_DUMP=0 RPCHAT_REQUEST_DUMP=0 node --import tsx bench/chatEventContract.test.ts && node --import tsx bench/chatEventStream.test.ts && node --import tsx bench/chatEventReconnect.test.ts
scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace apps/server & npm run dev --workspace apps/web
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace apps/web && npm run build --workspace apps/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace apps/server && npm run typecheck --workspace apps/web
